# Lucide sidebar icon attribution

Upstream: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/1.17.0

Official notice checked 2026-10-28:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/1.17.0/LICENSE

The complete upstream LICENSE is preserved beside this file, including
Copyright (c) 2026 Lucide Icons and Contributors (ISC) and the Feather-derived
icon notice, Copyright (c) 2013-present Cole Bemis (MIT).

Only the fourteen sidebar glyphs described in `shared/sidebar-icons/manifest.json`
are included. The PNG adaptations preserve their shapes and use a 1.7-unit
stroke plus a black alpha template for native tinting.

The generator also copies the full notice to the Android asset
`licenses/lucide-sidebar-icons.txt` and the iOS data asset
`CocoSidebarLucideLicense`, so distributing a compiled application retains it.
